title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: US stocks subdued after jobs report fuels rate-hike bets - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: US stocks opened largely muted on Friday after stronger-than-expected jobs data boosted bets that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates this month. The Dow fell 0.19%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq edged higher, as investors assessed the latest labor market signals.
